Robotic Control Infrastructure: Work closely with control algorithm and hardware teams to produce a software system for control of a quadruped robotic platform. positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Uncalibrated Grasping: Developing a grasping technique for robotic manipulators that doesn’t require significant calibration and utilizes perception techniques to yield an efficient method of grasping unknown objects. 
Lego Building Project: Developed perception stack for Baxter robotic platform to enable it to first recognize and then pick and place lego blocks in a workspace on a real robot.
Duties: Perception algorithms, programming robotic manipulator, ROS software development, camera calibration

courses.name: Component and Design Tech/ Digital Systems

projects.title: Compression Buffer Project
projects.description: Utilized LZ4 algorithm to compress debugging packets and store them in variably sized circular buffer. Circular buffer, packet architecture and unit tests were designed from scratch to be thread safe and minimize both processor overhead and memory usage. Project enabled debugging data to be stored in the background and transferred at a later time over the air.

projects.title: OpenROV Acoustic Location System
projects.description:
Developed software for underwater location system using acoustic signals and an FIR filter for embedded systems design course. Utilized STM32F4 microprocessor to process incoming analog signals and determine time difference of arrival.

Duties: DAC interfacing, circular buffer implementation, documentation, driver development
